summary: TIME AI (offline Expo app) first-run frontend test on mobile viewport 390x844. Today dashboard, Calendar, Agent and Hub tabs all load. Agent natural-language commands (add task, create goal, add habit, note, schedule meeting, plan my day, help, undo) correctly produce PROPOSED ACTIONS which require explicit approval and apply successfully (verified by cross-module data appearance). All 21 Hub module tiles navigate without red screen or crash. Tasks screen FAB + bottom-sheet form creates a task (submit button needs scroll-into-view). Calendar supports day/week/month/year/agenda views. Settings theme-dark toggle and data integrity check work. AsyncStorage persistence verified across page reload. Deprecated package detected: expo-router/unstable-native-tabs (warning in logs).

ui_bugs.issue: On 390x844 viewport the form-submit-button (Save) renders at y=768 inside the bottom sheet; it is reachable but requires scroll-into-view. First tap may be reported as 'outside of the viewport' by Playwright. Users on short devices may need to scroll the sheet. Reference: /app/frontend/src/ui/forms.ts / /app/frontend/src/ui/overlay.tsx

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated API in use. Console warning: '`expo-router/unstable-native-tabs` is deprecated. Use `expo-router/native-tabs` instead.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx and /app/frontend/src/navigation.ts

action_items: Migrate from `expo-router/unstable-native-tabs` to the stable `expo-router/native-tabs` import in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx and src/navigation.ts
Make the bottom-sheet form content scrollable (or shrink its height) so form-submit-button is comfortably within the 844px viewport without needing scroll on first open
critical_code_review_comments: Agent interpret() in /app/frontend/src/engine/agent.ts has correct ordering: help/memory/reminder/plan/schedule-N-hours/move/break-project/study/conflicts/free/brief/review/complete/delete/habit/goal/project/workspace/note/event/task — verified no regex fall-through found during testing.

FlatList in agent.tsx uses `inverted` with pre-sorted descending data (b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt)); this is correct and preserves correct visual order but note that DOM order of children becomes oldest-first (relevant for test selectors).
db.ts uses AsyncStorage; persistence confirmed after reload. Good.
seed_data_creation: During testing created: task 'Write essay' (via agent, session-scoped), goal 'Read 12 books by 2026-12-31', habit 'Drink water', note 'Ideas', task 'TEST_Groceries'. Persistence verified post-reload for TEST_Groceries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully offline (AsyncStorage via src/store/db.ts). Use mobile viewport 390x844. Agent FlatList is inverted (b.createdAt desc) — DOM order of [data-testid=agent-reply-message] is oldest-first, so use .last to assert on the newest reply. All forms are overlay bottom sheets (testID=bottom-sheet) with field-* and form-submit-button; may need .scroll_into_view_if_needed() before clicking submit on short viewports. Confirm dialogs: confirm-ok-button / confirm-cancel-button. Tab bar uses native tabs; navigate via get_by_text(label).first.click() for Today/Calendar/Agent/Hub, or direct URLs /tasks /calendar /settings /queue etc. 21 Hub modules all loaded successfully in this run.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — no app bugs found. Two intermittent test-side failures in first pass were caused by (a) FlatList inverted DOM ordering (used .first instead of .last on agent replies, picked up stale 'New task:' reply), and (b) form-submit-button at the bottom of the bottom-sheet needs scroll_into_view_if_needed in web preview. Both were re-verified and passed in the follow-up run.
